subject: world_language
concept: Final mastery check and reflection on the complete K-12 world languages journey, confirming near-native (C2) proficiency and readiness for post-secondary or applied language use
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative capstone review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews a timeline of their own language journey from Pre-A1 first words through C2 capstone mastery
exercise.abstract: Student completes a comprehensive capstone assessment drawing on the full range of proficiency skills built across all grade levels, and reflects in writing on their growth across the complete K-12 sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed capstone question types, plus a passing independent capstone project and reflection at C2 level
misconception_flags: any capstone-unit misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.G12.CAPSTONE_MASTERY.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
